title: Deltarune Explosion
blurb: Gloriously scuffed, slightly too loud, and precisely as dramatic as it is ridiculous. Toby Fox's explosion sound is a great example of his approach to audio: it does not attempt realism, it attempts effect, and it lands somewhere between a real detonation and a cartoon one. Fans know it from the chapters' more chaotic moments; everyone else simply hears a perfect comedy blast. Use it when something detonates narratively rather than physically — a secret revealed, an argument comprehensively destroyed, the group chat at three in the morning.
origin: The explosion sound from Deltarune (Toby Fox).
